claim: Moric's old vines re-argued the grape as 'the Pinot of the East'.
because: In a question that keys Leithaberg, this line presents Moric as the Leithaberg example. fix: Leithaberg DAC red must be Blaufränkisch, grown on the limestone and schist of the Leitha hills; Moric's old vines at Neckenmarkt and Lutzmannsburg (Mittelburgenland) made the wider case for the grape as 'the Pinot of the East'.
